- [USER] User asked about Coca-Cola's prioritization of sustainability in its supply chain.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Coca-Cola prioritizes sustainability in its supply chain through several initiatives.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In 2020, Coca-Cola set a goal to reach net-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2040 across its entire value chain, including its suppliers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Coca-Cola invests in more sustainable manufacturing and packaging practices, such as using recyclable and plant-based materials in its packaging.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Coca-Cola works closely with its suppliers to reduce their environmental impact, implementing sustainable farming and agricultural practices.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Coca-Cola has a Sustainable Agriculture Guiding Principles program that outlines expectations for suppliers regarding water usage, biodiversity protection, and deforestation avoidance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Coca-Cola has implemented a water stewardship program aimed at reducing water usage in manufacturing processes and replenishing water resources in local communities.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Coca-Cola's overall focus is on reducing environmental impact, improving supplier sustainability practices, and investing in sustainable manufacturing and packaging methods.
- [USER] User requested examples of how Coca-Cola has implemented its sustainable agriculture program with suppliers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In Brazil, Coca-Cola works with sugarcane farmers to implement sustainable farming practices, providing training and technical assistance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In China, Coca-Cola collaborates with tea farmers to reduce pesticide and fertilizer use, offering training and support for sustainable practices.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In Kenya, Coca-Cola assists mango farmers in improving productivity and reducing waste through better irrigation and harvesting methods.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Coca-Cola's Sustainable Agriculture Guiding Principles program aims to help suppliers adopt sustainable practices that reduce environmental impact and support long-term business viability.
- [USER] User expressed curiosity about how to ensure Coca-Cola's sustainability initiatives are making a significant environmental impact.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Coca-Cola measures the impact of its sustainability initiatives through various metrics and indicators.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Coca-Cola tracks packaging waste and has set a goal to collect and recycle the equivalent of 100% of its packaging by 2030.
